item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.8
item.description: - Safer pasting: keys you press while a paste is still finishing now wait a moment and then go in, in order, so they can't land on top of the paste. - A quick second ⌘V is never lost: into the same app it pastes again; into another app it's a normal paste there. - No more double pastes when an app is slow to answer. - Very large copies get a normal paste, and a paste that gets stuck stops by itself instead of blocking ⌘V. - Show Log (right-click the menu bar icon) replaces Log to Desktop. The log keeps the last 30 days, in your local time, and never includes what you copied. - "Remove emojis" in Settings; the History box no longer changes size when you click Show all.
